bug_semantics: POST /api/av/getAttributeViewSearchTarget was registered with model.CheckAuth only. CheckAuth admits RoleReader (publish-mode anonymous/reader sessions). The handler getAttributeViewSearchTarget in kernel/api/av.go parses id and keywords and calls model.GetAttributeViewSearchTarget with no IsReadOnlyRoleContext, CheckAttributeViewBlockAccessableByPublishAccess, FilterAttributeViewByPublishAccess, or isEncryptedNotebookDeniedForPublish. The sink walks every attribute-view key/value with strings.Contains, including ParseAttributeViewInBox on unlocked encrypted notebooks, and returns Title plus MatchedKeyID for a matching row. A reader copies a database block id from a published page they are allowed to view and retrieves rows that renderAttributeView would have stripped. Adjacent /api/av routes (getAttributeViewFieldViews, searchAttributeView, getAttributeView) already used CheckReadonly; this new route did not.
